entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit customer support, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I... I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Gable, order number VF78551. I just... I feel so silly calling about this.
Not at all, Sarah. I've pulled up your account. I see you received the VeloBand on December 15th. Can I ask, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it works fine. It's just... I honestly changed my mind. It was a total impulse buy, and I really don't use it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited, but with bills piling up... I really need the money back.
I understand. So it's not a defect, you just found it wasn't the right fit for you after all. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I was even thinking about trying for a resale online, but it just seems like such a hassle and I'm not sure I'd get the full value back.
Alright Sarah, I've just reviewed our policy here. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window. So, yes, we can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you so much, David. That's a huge relief.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could help you with this. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've really made my day. I appreciate your help.
It was my pleasure, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
